data.name: Box Hunt
data.detailed_description:
My Dad made a game for me and my brother back when I was very young called "Box Hunt". His game was for a very old version of windows and he never put his game out for release to the public. I've asked him to remake his game so I could add it as a possible DLC to this game in the future after this game is complete. His game was very basic, a room that spawned in boxes, had infinite levels, nothing special.

WHAT MAKES THIS GAME DIFFERENT?

This game, Box Hunt generates a procedural maze where you go through and hunting these white glowing boxes. Some parts of the mazes you may encounter will be dark, and that's okay. your bullets will light the path.

WHAT IS A "RELAXING SHOOTER" GAME?

Well, to put it simply, it's exactly as it sounds. You fly around a procedural maze and hunt boxes.

That's literally it. You're not stressed on time, there's no need to rush, oh, and nothing can hurt you, NOTHING, I promise! Just sit back, relax, enjoy a peaceful shooting game.

data.short_description: Enjoy this relaxing shooter game where you fly around a procedural maze and hunting boxes. Create custom levels, choose from room presets that you can experience throughout normal levels of the game, and use your bullets to light your path in dark spaces!
